events.name: Tynecastle Stadium Tour & Museum Experience
events.description:
An exclusive glimpse behind the scenes! We reveal the inner workings of the Club and its rich history, in a  fun and informative way with our guided full Stadium Tour.  
Tour Highlights:  

90 Minute Tour Experience  
Experienced Private Tour Guide   
Small Groups 
Access to restricted areas around the whole Stadium 
Family friendly and accessible  
 10% discount voucher for the Clubstore after the tour! 

Join our experienced Tour Guides to hear stories of the rich history  our club as you visit key locations around the Stadium. Highlights  include the Museum, Memorial Garden, dressing rooms, tunnel, dugouts and  media suite.   Stand where the gaffer stands on a match day!   
With plenty of photo opportunities along the way, our family friendly tour is great for sports fans and history buffs of all ages and  customers will have access to the club store afterwards. 
*Please note that Tynecastle Park is a working stadium and as such, tour routes will occasionally be adjusted for essential stadium  works and events 
The meeting point for the Stadium Tour is inside the Heart of Midlothian Museum,  the entrance gates are located at Wheatfield Street (just off Gorgie  Road). We encourage tour customers to arrive early to spend a little  time taking in the Museum exhibitions. Tours will last no more than 1.5  hours.

Come for the Tour, Stay for Lunch! The award-winning  Skyline Restaurant, on the top floor of Tynecastle Park, is open seven  days a week for breakfast, lunch and dinner are served on Friday and Saturday.  Our menus are a  celebration of seasonal ingredients and flavours and cater to all tastes  and preferences! For more info or to book your table - bit.ly/TheSkylineRestaurant

venues.name: Tynecastle Park

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Heart of Midlothian Ticket Centre: Telephone: 0871 663 1874, option 1 (24 hours)
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday-Wednesday and Friday - 9am-5pm Thursdays - 10am-5pm Saturdays - 10am-2pm Sundays - Closed Matchdays - 10am-kick-off

venues.parkingDetail: There are no special parking arrangements and traffic wardens strictly control street parking in the immediate vicinity of the stadium. Hearts encourages supporters to use public transport. To the north of the stadium, there is some on-street parking available north of Murrayfield Stadium and Corstorphine Road. To the south of the stadium, there is some on-street parking available south of Gorgie Road and in the Shandon area.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Wheelchair and carer seats are situated in the Wheatfield, Gorgie and Roseburn Stand. Limited car parking spaces usually taken up by season ticket holders. For disabled bookings, please call 0871 663 1874, (then option 8 for customer services during working hours).

generalInfo.childRule: There are no age restrictions for attendance. However, everyone attending the match must be allocated a seat. This includes all children and babies. Concession tickets can be purchased for children aged 18 years or under and 65 and over. Students in full time education can also be sold a concession ticket however they will need to show student ID when entering the ground.
